prompt: You draw one card at random from a full standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is an ace or a king?
explanation: There are 4 aces and 4 kings, so 8 winning cards out of 52. That gives 8/52, and dividing top and bottom by 4 simplifies it to 2/13.
